Loads a picture file into an image with one frame. Pixels that are black are drawn as transparent by [DrawImage](DrawImage) until [MaskImage](MaskImage) picks another color. Load images once at the start of a program and draw them often. If the file is missing, the result is 0, so check it before drawing.

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
; Make a picture file first so that the example runs without any other file.
Local made = CreateImage(64, 64)
SetBuffer ImageBuffer(made)
Color 80, 200, 120
Oval 0, 0, 64, 64, 1
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
SaveImage made, "dot.bmp"

Local img = LoadImage("dot.bmp")
If img = 0 Then RuntimeError "dot.bmp could not be loaded"
Cls
DrawImage img, 128, 88
Flip
WaitKey
```
@param file  The path of the picture file. BMP, PNG, JPEG and other common formats can be loaded.
@returns A handle for the image, or 0 if the file could not be loaded.
@gap More file formats load than in the original, which read BMP, PNG, JPEG and TGA. Files are decoded by SDL_image, and DDS files (DXT1 to DXT5, BC4, BC5, BC7 and uncompressed pictures) by the runtime itself, and block compressed ones stay compressed on the graphics card until the image is drawn to. See [LoadTexture](LoadTexture) for the formats of DDS files that are read.
@gap Backslashes in paths are changed into slashes on Linux and macOS, and a name that is not found as written is looked for in any case, as on Windows.
